title: Annual Range, Median and Average Commission Paid by Housing Developers to Appointed Sales Agents
what_it_is: Annual Range, Median and Average Commission Paid by Housing Developers to Appointed Sales Agents

sections.label: Developer sales agent commissions
sections.summary: Commissions paid by housing developers to sales agents are a private contractual arrangement and the Government does not require disclosure.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The commissions paid by housing developers to their sales agents are a private contractual arrangement and the Government does not require this information to be disclosed.

sections.label: URA and sales commissions
sections.summary: URA does not ask for information on sales commissions, which are a private arrangement between developers and sales agents.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: In fact, URA does not ask for information on the commissions.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: I think he also said that the report said that the Ministry would engage the developers for information and provide feedback.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: I think the engagement of developers is something URA and the Ministry does regularly, but specifically on sales commissions, as I have mentioned, the Government does not collect data on that; and that is a private arrangement between the developers and the sales agents.
